meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service

copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 将 Python（Flask/Django/FastAPI）代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux。它会自动创建资源组、托管计划和 Web App，配置启动命令，部署代码，并打印后续提示，不执行部署后健康检查。
howto.when: 当你提到“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”等关键词，或要求“部署 Python 到 App Service”时触发。

say.text: 把我的 Flask 代码部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: Claude 会创建资源并部署代码。

say.text: 部署 Django 应用到 App Service
say.note: 走 azure.yaml 或 az 部署流程。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. It creates resource group, plan and web app if missing, configures startup, deploys code, then prints a post-deploy message. No post-deploy health checks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions "Flask App Service", "Django App Service" etc., or asks to deploy Python to App Service. Not for Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, or IaC.

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask code to Azure App Service
say_en.note: Claude creates resources and deploys code.

say_en.text: Deploy a Django app to App Service
say_en.note: Uses azd or az deploy path.

say_en.text: Deploy a FastAPI project to App Service with uvicorn startup
say_en.note: Sets uvicorn startup command before deploy.
